properties.description: Class invariants across every pin state (export present, missing, at an address, nowhere, not a design, an export of another design), across none, one, two and several other designs, and across the node types a finding names: every finding is filed under exactly the designs its ids belong to (by_design, by_pair, across, of_the_whole) and every id it names opens with get_node in that design; not_composed names the same designs in the same states as the tracked search's not_searched; with one other design the findings equal the one-other-design composition's, ours/theirs/seam bucket for bucket; nothing is written (this design's export content hash and every member export's bytes are unchanged); the one-other-design reply is exactly the core's report under its old eight keys and its refusals keep their words; the reply fits budget_chars sampling only finding lists, with every count intact; through the --call door on the real binary a hub pinning two exports, a missing export and an address composes in one read with the members' pair finding; through a hub's address on a registry every member is read live and one outside the readable set is named unreachable revealing nothing. Each failed on main a8e3be969 first (the old-shape-through-a-hub test is a regression guard and passes on both).
